_template: Copy this to capture-NN.json and fill it in. Delete this key. Files named TEMPLATE.json are skipped by the harness only because they contain no assets - there is no special case for them, so leave the assets object empty here.
notes: Things known to be true that a photograph cannot show. These do not become labels.
They are how we find out what this product is structurally blind to.

_asset_help.labels_empty_list: A human looked and there is nothing to report. Findings here are false positives. Most assets should look like this.
_asset_help.asset_absent: Nobody looked. Predictions are ignored rather than counted wrong.
_asset_help.box: Normalized. x,y is the top-left corner. All values 0..1. Need not be tight - matching is at IoU 0.4 (D-008).
_asset_help.severity: Optional, one of info / minor / major / critical - the vocabulary in models.Severity, not the one docs/EVAL.md describes. Leave it out if you are not sure; a missing severity is counted as missing and the pair is left out of the confusion matrix, which is the honest outcome. A misspelled one stops the harness rather than being read as missing.
_asset_help.severity_is_not_detection: Grading is scored separately from finding. A box we located correctly and graded wrongly is a true positive with a severity error, so do not withhold a label because our severity disagrees with yours.
_asset_help.do_not_label: brakes, restraints, structure, steering - LAW 2, we have disclaimed assessing these from a photograph
